entries.speaker: Fussy Man
entries.en: Wasn't there a rumor going around that[n]the Phantom Thieves were murdering[n]people?
entries.uk: Хіба не ходили чутки, що Фантомні[n]Злодії вбивали людей?

entries.en: I knew they were no good the moment[n]that stuff came up. I bet they're just[n]a bunch of scumbags.
